column1: # Sentences for scripts/eval-clipboard.sh in languages other than English, Russian and Ukrainian:
# German, French, Spanish, Italian, Polish, Portuguese, Dutch, Czech. P = asks for the clipboard to be
# pasted, N = does not. Tab-separated. Written for the examples to be tuned against, so they are NOT a
# measurement of the shipped lookup; scripts/clipboard-requests-intl-heldout.tsv is, and it was not
# looked at while tuning. Several are near misses on purpose: copying TO the clipboard, pasting
# something ELSE, only talking about it, "do not paste yet".
